UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile and persistent game save data for Cock a Doodle.

unlockedLevel.description: Highest unlocked level number from 1 to 40.

armor.description: Equipped armor type (none, iron, gold, diamond, netherite, coral).

sword.description: Equipped sword type (none, iron, gold, diamond, coral, netherite).

hasShield.description: Whether player has acquired the shield.

hasAxe.description: Whether player has acquired the woodcutter axe.

hasBrush.description: Whether player has acquired the archaeology brush.

hasCompletedGame.description: Whether player defeated Cockatrice in Level 30.

BossRushScore.title: BossRushScore
BossRushScore.description: Public leaderboard entry storing a verified player's Boss Rush fastest clear time.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who achieved the score.

playerName.description: Public display nickname for the leaderboard (never raw email PII).

clearTimeMs.description: Total Boss Rush completion time in milliseconds (1000 to 3600000).

difficulty.description: Difficulty setting during the Boss Rush run.

gender.description: Chicken character gender used during the run.

bonusCoins.description: Bonus coins earned in the Boss Rush run.

createdAt.description: Server-assigned Firestore timestamp when the clear was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user account profile and persistent progress for registered players.

/bossRushScores/{scoreId}.description: Stores verified players' Boss Rush clear times for the Top 5 fastest clear times leaderboard.
